description: Defines constants, assertions, and the QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer class for managing MTU discovery in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: quic::QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer
classes.description: A controller class for managing MTU discovery, including probe scheduling and size determination.

methods.name: quic::QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer()
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes in disabled state.

methods.name: quic::QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer(QuicPacketCount, QuicPacketNumber)
methods.description: Constructor with parameters for initial probe settings.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables MTU probing with specified max and target packet sizes.

methods.name: ShouldProbeMtu
methods.description: Determines if an MTU probe should be sent at the current state.

methods.name: GetUpdatedMtuProbeSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the MTU probe packet before sending.

methods.name: OnMaxPacketLengthUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal state after max packet length changes.

methods.name: packets_between_probes
methods.description: Returns the number of packets between MTU probes.

methods.name: next_probe_at
methods.description: Returns the packet number after which the next probe will be sent.
